name: Damak (Hungary)
description: White field charged at the centre with the municipal arms of Damak: a blue shield with a yellow charge inscribed DAMAK, with a helm, a figure crest holding a sabre and blue, red and yellow mantling.
history: Hungarian municipal symbols are adopted by decree of the local representative body (képviselő-testület); the flag carries the colours of the municipal arms.

features.role: Damak arms with helm, crest and mantling
